snippet.title: Kindawn The Parish Remembers — Trailer | ENG
snippet.description:
You return to your hometown in the Far North - a place that shaped you, broke you, and quietly waited for your return. It is the early 2000s: the echoes of the post-Soviet crisis still ring in the walls of leaning wooden houses. Yet beneath the apparent darkness of everyday life lies something far older. In Kindawn, the permafrost preserves not only human fates, but also unresolved secrets of the past.

Kindawn: The Parish Remembers will be released in May 2026 for PC (Steam and VK Play platforms). Wishlist now on Steam!

More about the projects: newgameplus.games
Developed by ArchReality studio and published by “New Game+”.
